Title: [LSJ] Playing Modifiers / Reaction cards outside the block sequence

Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
There is a rule prohibiting a minion to play a given modifier / reaction
card a second time for the same action.

Example: it is forbidden to modify two times with Lost in Crowds.

Does this rule only belong to the block sequence or is this a general
rule?

Example: May I bribe a given vote multiple times (A Consangineous Boon
which is bribed 3-4 times would be fun), or playing multiple Dread Gazes
with the same Vampire?

And:

Does superior Form of Mist counts as a modifier (continue as unblocked),
or is it just a combat card which generates a stealthy effect? (And: May
I play sup. FoM multiple times if blocked multiple times, and how much
stealth do I get?)

Michael Beer

Messages.Author: Lupus Australis
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 8 Feb 1998, Michael Beer wrote:

> There is a rule prohibiting a minion to play a given modifier / reaction
> card a second time for the same action.
>
> Example: it is forbidden to modify two times with Lost in Crowds.
>
> Does this rule only belong to the block sequence or is this a general
> rule?
>
> Example: May I bribe a given vote multiple times (A Consangineous Boon
> which is bribed 3-4 times would be fun), or playing multiple Dread Gazes
> with the same Vampire?

It is one action modifier per action per minion. The only way a
Consanguinous Boon could be bribed 3 or 4 times would be with the help of
2 or 3 Mask of 1000 Faces--so that 3 or 4 minions could cooperate in
modifying the action.

Multiple Dread Gazes could be played in reaction to an action, but not by
the same vampire.

> And:
>
> Does superior Form of Mist counts as a modifier (continue as unblocked),
> or is it just a combat card which generates a stealthy effect? (And: May
> I play sup. FoM multiple times if blocked multiple times, and how much
> stealth do I get?)

I'll leave that one to LSJ.

Lupus Australis

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Michael Beer wrote:
> There is a rule prohibiting a minion to play a given modifier / reaction
> card a second time for the same action.
>

> Does this rule only belong to the block sequence or is this a general
> rule?

It is a general rule:

3.2.2. Minion Cards
...
Important rule: A minion cannot use two identical action modifier cards to
affect the same action.
...
A minion cannot use two identical reaction cards to react to an action.

> Example: May I bribe a given vote multiple times (A Consangineous Boon
> which is bribed 3-4 times would be fun), or playing multiple Dread Gazes
> with the same Vampire?

No and no.

> And:
>
> Does superior Form of Mist counts as a modifier (continue as unblocked),
> or is it just a combat card which generates a stealthy effect? (And: May
> I play sup. FoM multiple times if blocked multiple times, and how much
> stealth do I get?)

No. Yes. Yes. +1 each.
